STA Knowledge Base — Module Catalog

Every research and reference module in the STA scope of the knowledge base, grouped by area with a one-line summary of each. This is the domain expertise The Architect draws from when building and running STA's AI projects.
AI Admin · Not for general staff distribution
70 STA modules · 10 areas
What this is. The knowledge base is split into two scopes that share one index: STA (work-context modules used to build, train, and run STA's AI system) and Adam (personal-project modules). This catalog lists the STA scope only. Modules live under knowledge-base/sta/… and are pulled into projects by path during The Architect's Phase 2 KB Check. The number on the right of each row is how many sub-modules that topic contains.
Keep this current. New modules are added to knowledge-base/index.md as research is commissioned. When the index gains or loses an STA row, this catalog should be regenerated from it so the two stay in sync.
